writes_to: ~/aiso_platform_runs/platform_runs/<run_id>/ (own folder; the machine's benchmark tree results/ and logs/ are never touched)
selection: one model, or all one-GPU models once
progress_lines: vllm/<model> NP=1 input=4000 R=1 PASS|FAIL agg=<tok/s> ttft_ms=<ms> tpot_ms=<ms>
